response.rationale: The English cue and Indonesian answer are sound. Malaysian “pendingin hawa” is valid and understood, but Malaysian terminology guidance treats it as an older term and prefers “penyaman udara”; “aircond” is also common colloquially. The different-common-word relation therefore overstates the contrast, and no false-friend contrast is present.
